column1: #   Arm A is verbatim slate_kv_core::task::block_on (busy poll + spin_loop). Arm B is the same loop without the spin
#   hint (model 1) or parking the thread 100 us per Pending instead of spinning (model 2).
# Workload: put + commit through Slate::commit_async
#   Model 2 additionally forces an epoch seal every 100 records so the run actually contains erases.
# Two flash models
#   BlockingFlash<SimFlash> -- the PRODUCTION sync facade. No future ever suspends for an I/O reason

#   DeadlineFlash -- erase suspends for a REAL 45 000 us (W25Q tSE typical) before completing
#     DMA/interrupt-backed QSPI driver of doc 018 §6. Both executors face the identical 45 ms wait; only what they do
#     during it differs.
# Statistic is the MEDIAN of the listed reps
